tags.notes: Intercity and metropolitan coach services ARTESP regulates across São Paulo state, distinct from f-6gy-sptrans which is the city network. The dataset holds two GTFS resources under different UUIDs and the older one is what the public catalogs list; this is the newer build (feed_version 20260908 against 20260610). Ask the CKAN API for the dataset's current resources rather than assuming this UUID survives a re-upload.
